sources.supports: Voluntarily chosen leisure includes diverse activities; reported associations do not establish an individual causal effect.
sources.limits: Later find requests returned a browser-check page; no later body, full limitations section or linked studies are credited. PEAT scale not administered or reproduced. Does not validate the ten-day play protocol, three rest periods, four puzzle sessions, a health claim or an enjoyment score.
